blocks.text: Buying a Home in Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Chilliwack

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Highway 1 (Exits 109 through 135), Vedder Road, Yale Road, Luckakuck Way, and Evans Road. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Chilliwack will find detached single-family houses, strata townhomes in Sardis and Promontory, low-rise condos around District 1881 and Garrison Crossing, hillside view homes, and ALR farms. For a full breakdown of official community plans, catchment maps, and hazard overlays, read our
Chilliwack Neighbourhood Guides

Families looking at homes for sale in Chilliwack are served by Chilliwack School District 33 (SD33), including Sardis Secondary, G.W. Graham Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary, and Imaging/UFV Canada Education Park. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include the Vedder River Rotary Trail, Sardis Park, Mount Thom Park, Cheam Leisure Centre, Central Community Park, and Island 22 Regional Park. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit routes 51 Vedder, 52 Evans, 53 Fairfield, 54 Promontory, 55 Yarrow-Greendale, and Route 66 Fraser Valley Express to Abbotsford, Langley (Carvolth), and Burnaby (Lougheed SkyTrain).

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Chilliwack

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Chilliwack are regulated by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 5500), the Sardis and Downtown Neighbourhood Plans, Development Permit Area 2 (hillside and upland slopes), and Fraser/Vedder floodplain bylaws. Before removing subjects on a property in Chilliwack, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our
BC Property Transfer Tax Calculator
and
First-Time Buyer Calculator

What types of homes are for sale in Chilliwack?

Active MLS® listings in Chilliwack typically include detached single-family houses, strata townhomes in Sardis and Promontory, low-rise condos around District 1881 and Garrison Crossing, hillside view homes, and ALR farms. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Chilliwack in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Chilliwack include Chilliwack School District 33 (SD33), including Sardis Secondary, G.W. Graham Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary, and Imaging/UFV Canada Education Park. Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Chilliwack?
Residents of Chilliwack have access to the Vedder River Rotary Trail, Sardis Park, Mount Thom Park, Cheam Leisure Centre, Central Community Park, and Island 22 Regional Park. See our
Chilliwack Neighbourhood Guides
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Chilliwack?

Key road corridors serving Chilliwack include Highway 1 (Exits 109 through 135), Vedder Road, Yale Road, Luckakuck Way, and Evans Road. Public transit connections include BC Transit routes 51 Vedder, 52 Evans, 53 Fairfield, 54 Promontory, 55 Yarrow-Greendale, and Route 66 Fraser Valley Express to Abbotsford, Langley (Carvolth), and Burnaby (Lougheed SkyTrain).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Chilliwack?

Properties in Chilliwack are governed by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 5500), the Sardis and Downtown Neighbourhood Plans, Development Permit Area 2 (hillside and upland slopes), and Fraser/Vedder floodplain bylaws. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Chilliwack freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Chilliwack are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
